notes.summary: Collapsing Star gains range after casting begins and loses its cancellation cooldown. Its Fury-drain slowdown is capped at about 1.5 full casts across retries. For Void-Scarred, Demonic Intensity moves The Hunt reset to Collapsing Star and empowers Hunt damage by 30%; Violent Transformation resets Soul Immolation, losing its Hunt reset and damage bonus. Monster Rising changes outside-form Intellect from 15% to 10% and Collapsing Star damage from 15% to 20%.
